content: Kerehuni kemɨtiwara'iwaxɨ mariyanitsixi

Yeruwahari ―tatsɨari Kerehuni― meta yunaitɨ teɨteri ximeripaitɨ me'anuku'uka mekanekɨne, haixa Karuri mɨtitewa matiniere mekanitiyaxe. Mariyanitsixi memakutekai wayeta katini'anekaitɨni, mayeweritsie hɨri Mure hetɨa.
Hikɨ Yawé Kerehuni, mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Yuwaɨkawame teɨteri pepɨwarawitɨkɨ nemɨwayetɨanikeyu mariyanitsixi xehetsɨa. Tietɨ 'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ memɨteniu'eri kename yukɨmana mete'uyuri,

mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi hikɨ: “Kemɨ'ane muyɨyɨakani marikakɨ, ke'ukunuani hɨri Karaha tematitei yukie keheyani”». 'Ana yu'utɨma mekanekɨne xeitewiyari heimana huta miriyari, tamamata miriyari mekaniyuhayewa.

Peru Yawé Kerehuni mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «'Akuxi teɨteri mekaniyuwaɨkawani. Hapa keniwarukatetɨa, mana nepɨwaranuyehapani 'ahetsiemieme. Xɨka mɨpaɨ nehaineni: “'Ikɨ 'a'utɨa kanimieni”, mɨkɨ kanimieni, peru xɨka mɨpaɨ nehaineni: “'Ikɨ 'a'utɨa pɨkamie”, mɨkɨ pɨkamie».
Kerehuni hapa teɨteri kaniwarukatetɨani. Mana Yawé mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Kemɨ'ane yunenikɨ memɨtihareni tsɨikɨri wahepaɨ keniwarupata, 'iyata metitunuma'utɨ memɨtihareni xaɨtsie».
Haika tsienituyari teɨteri mekaniutihareni yumamakɨ me'enatihanɨwetɨ yuteta meheitatu'atɨ. Hipatɨ yunaitɨ metitunuma'utɨ mekaniutihareni.
Yawé Kerehuni mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Haika tsienituyarikɨ teɨteri memutihari yunenikɨ, ne nepɨxetawikweitsitɨani, mariyanitsixi ne nepɨmatsiyetuirieni. Hipatɨta memuyuhayewaxɨ yukie mekehekɨne».

Hikɨ Kerehuni hipame 'ixaheritsixi kaniwarenɨ'ani yukie, haika tsienituyari xeikɨa kaniwarukunuitɨani, 'ikwaite mekateniukunuitɨani meta 'awate hɨtsieriwame. Mariyanitsixi mematitekai mayeweritsie pɨti'anekai, wayeta paitɨ Kerehuni mepɨtitekai.
Mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie Yawé Kerehuni mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Xekenanuku'uti mematiteitsie xekeneukakɨni, nekaniwayetuamɨkɨ Mariyanitsixi.
Xɨka peheumaka pemɨwatakwinikɨ, kenaye'axi meri matsiparewiwame, Pura hamatɨa,
mana ketinetamari kemɨretaine. 'Anake pepɨyɨwekaxɨani pemɨwatakwini mematiteitsie». Hikɨ Pura hamatɨa 'iparewiwameya mekaneukakɨne tehɨwemete memati'upaitɨ, mematitei manuye'atɨkatsie.

Mariyanitsixi, 'amarekitsixi, meta hipatɨ teɨteri tau manatineika hepatsie kiekatari mana mekanititekaitɨni mayeweritsie, mekaniyumɨirekaitɨni 'utsikari wehepaɨ mekateniyuxexeiyakaitɨni. Wakameyutsixi mepɨkayu'inɨatsinɨakai, xiekari haramara tetsita mɨtika hepaɨ.

Kerehuni mana kaninuani yemekɨ xewitɨ yuheinɨtsi yuhamiku kuxaxatɨwakaku. Mɨpaɨ katinikuxatakaitɨni: ―Mɨpaɨ nepɨtiuheinɨ, tsewara payari tematitei mariyanitsixi kaninuani 'uxikɨriwarumetɨ, kepauka 'ixuriki kiyaritsie mukawautsekai mɨkɨ kanatixɨrɨwekaitɨni.
Hamikuya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Mɨkɨ tixaɨtɨ pɨti'inɨariyari, 'ixaheri tewiyari 'ixiparaya kanihɨkɨtɨni Kerehuni Kuhatsi nu'aya. Kakaɨyari kaniyetuirieni mariyanitsixi meta tinaime 'ena mɨtikupine.

Kepauka Kerehuni heinɨtsika mu'eni meta kemɨtiuhekɨatsie, kaniutihɨximakeni. Hikɨ mekanakunuaxɨani 'ixaheritsixi mematiteitsie mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Xekenanuku'uti. Yawé mariyanitsixi kanixeyetuirieni».
Kerehuni me'ayehaikame kaniwarayeitɨani, xeitsienituyaritsixi meyupapaɨmeme 'awa kaniwaruta'ɨitɨani meta tai mepu'ɨkai xarikɨ 'anukanatɨkaime.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Xekenene'ɨkeni kenemɨtiyurieneni. Kepauka mematitei temaye'axɨaximeni yaxeikɨa xeketeneyurieka kenemɨtiyurieneni ne.
Kepauka ne meta memɨnetsi'aweiya 'awate temɨtihɨtsieni, xemeta xemeitihɨtsieni mematitei wawaritatsie, mɨpaɨ xemetiyuani: “Yawé hetsiemieme meta Kerehuni hetsiemieme”».

Kerehuni meta teɨteri xeitsienituyari hamatɨana memuhukai, mematitekaitsie manuyeniere mekaniu'axɨani tɨkari hixɨapa tehɨwemete memayutipatatsie, kepauka hutarieka tehɨwemete memanutahaxɨanikekaitsie. 'Awate mekaniutihɨtsieni meta xarite mekaniutitara kwiepa.

Me'ayuyehaikatɨ 'awate mekaniutihɨtsieni meta xarite mekaniutitara. Tai mekaniuti'ɨni yu'utakɨ, yutseriekɨ 'awa me'u'ɨtɨ memitihɨtsienikekai, mɨpaɨ mekateniuhiwa: «Yu'ixipara xekenewatihapani, Yawé hetsiemieme meta Kerehuni hetsiemieme».
Yuxexuitɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekana'utɨkɨne mematiteitsie, hikɨ yunaitɨ mariyanitsixi mekaniutinautsa me'utitsuatɨ.

Kepauka haika tsienituyari 'awate mutiyua, Yawé yakatiniuyurieni mɨkɨ teɨteri mana memukutekai yukɨmana mekaniuyutakwini yu'ixiparakɨ. Mɨkɨ mekaniuyuta'una Weti-Tsita paitɨ, Tserera hepatsie, 'Aweri-Mekura kiekariyari manuye'atɨka paitɨ, Tawati kiekariyaritsie heuhurakaku.
Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekaniuta'inierieni, Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimama, 'Atsexi xiɨyarimama meta yunaitɨ Manatsexi xiɨyarimama, mɨkɨ mariyanitsixi mekaniwaranukuweiya.

Naitsarie hɨritsie 'Epɨrahini kwieyaritsie Kerehuni texaxatamete kaniwarutanɨ'ani mɨpaɨ me'utiyuaneme: «Xekeniwaruhupiexɨa yeuta meta hamuxapa mariyanitsixi, Kurutani hatuxameyaritsie manuyeyɨkɨtɨkatsie xekenanu'uixɨa, Weti-Wara paitɨ ye'atɨkaimetsie mexi mɨkɨ meka'anukɨniwawe». 'Epɨrahini nuiwarimama yunaitɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenikakɨne kememɨte'utahɨawarie.

'Ana 'Urewi mekaniuwiya meta Tsewi, yuhutame mariyanitsixi wa'ukiyarima. 'Urewi mekaniumieni 'aitsie hikɨ mɨkɨ 'ai 'Urewi mekateniuterɨwa, Tsewi mekaniumieni kaxie takari matipɨnarɨwatsie hikɨ mana Tsewi mekateniuterɨwa. Mepɨkatehayewakai mewaruweiyatɨ mariyanitsixi, 'Urewi mu'uya meta Tsewi mu'uya Kerehuni mekanetɨkirieni, Kurutani hatuxameyari 'anutaɨye muyuhayewakai.
